title: Leafnode peers can forge JetStream acknowledgements outside their permissions
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

JetStream uses acknowledgement messages to track processing and, for some retention policies, determine when stored messages can be removed.

### Problem Description

The leafnode ingress path accepted JetStream acknowledgement subjects without evaluating the leafnode user’s publish permissions. A peer with restricted leafnode access could affect consumer state in its account and cause messages to be removed or cease redelivery without acknowledgement from the intended consumer.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.10 and v2.15.3. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-r9gv-x84w-62mr>
